kind.detail: BUG-2773 (completing). AC1: verified by bug2773_unbound_claim_with_dead_creator_is_listed_and_healed (collect_doctor_findings_at lists shared-<invocation> with safe_heal, targeted_stale_finding accepts it, heal_exited_claim deletes it). AC2: verified. coordination::shared_heal_id is the single predicate for doctor_root::shared_stale_finding and implementer_refusal; the flipped bug2655_force_refuses_fresh_or_live_creator_preserving_claim test asserts that fresh and live holders get no heal command. AC3: verified by the same AC1 test, which uses the dell1 shape (lease=unbound, launcher=unbound, dead creator with a legacy linux-starttime identity, heartbeat 2026-11-15). Bug protocol item 'the PR touches at least one test file': met (coordination.rs tests module). CI: fast gates green, including the store-writer inventory; fast compile was pending at review time. Request changes for one blocking defect. The new unbound branch of exited_holder_is_dead accepts a dead creator plus an expired TTL as death evidence. For a non-process-backed claim, both are true about 30 minutes after creation whatever the holder's state, so the branch never checks whether the holder clone still has a Live or Dormant session for the scope. The heal path and --force-claim admission both use this predicate, so both inherit the gap. A smaller p3 test gap is listed too.
